parameters.text:
=You are to classify emails, adhere to rules.

Subject: {{$json.subject}}  Full email: {{$json.text}}

messageValues.message:
=Allowed tags:
["job_search","response_needed","skippable","event","application_update","offer_related"]

Output format:
{ "tags": [],
  "reason": "",
  "event": {
    "title": "",
    "time": "",
    "location": "",
    "description": ""
  }
}

Rules:
- Use only the allowed tags.
- Use "job_search" tag if it's job search related.
- Include "response_needed" tag when the sender expects a reply, confirmation, RSVP, scheduling action, or other user action in order to further a process.
- Include "event" tag for meetings, interviews, appointments, conferences, webinars, or other scheduled online or offline events.
- Use "skippable" tag if the content is skippable useless information of low priority.
- "skippable" tag is mutually exclusive from any other tag. If an email should have tags other than "skippable", it must not have the "skippable" tag. If the email does not have any tags, it can be given the "skippable" tag.
- Use "application_update" tag if it's update news on applications related.
- Use "offer_related" tag if it's offer related.
- An event can be incomplete. Include the "event" tag if an event is clearly mentioned, even when the date, time, location, or title is missing.
- Populate event fields only with information explicitly stated or clearly implied by the email.
- Do not guess, invent, or infer missing event information.
- If a field is unknown or unavailable, use an empty string.
- Use ISO-8601 for the "time" field when a date or time is available.
- Always use Hong Kong time, UTC+08:00. Include the timezone offset in the ISO-8601 value, for example: "2026-10-25T14:00:00+08:00".
- If only a date is available, use the date only, for example: "2026-10-25".
- If the email gives a time but no date, do not invent a date; leave "time" empty or preserve only the explicitly provided time if your calendar node supports it.
- If an event has no confirmed time, leave "time" as an empty string.
- Keep "reason" concise and explain missing event details when relevant, explain why each tag is used, and why each unused tag is unused.
- Return valid JSON only, without markdown or additional text.
